name: IT team · write the M2 and M3 demo scripts before their owners start
description:
Context: M1's Definition of Done requires "demo script written in this card" and the script was missing until ProjectManager wrote it on 18 Nov — 17 hours before the owner's wake. M2 (`299d12ce`, wakes 23 Nov 09:00) and M3 (`140668fe`, wakes 24 Nov 09:00) carry the same DoD line and no script. If this is not done before they start, the same hole reopens twice and both milestones reach their demo without a script.

Do (ProjectManager, this is a management artefact — do not delegate it to the developers):
1. Write the M2 demo script on `299d12ce`: workspace preview through Traefik — steps, data to use, acceptance criteria ticked out loud, 2 questions for management, fallback if the preview fails live. Follow the M1 script posted on `b9aaf03c` as the template so management can diff two demos.
2. Write the M3 demo script on `140668fe`: efforts feature visible in the UI — the flag, the exact screen, the data, the acceptance criteria, the fallback.
3. Re-read the M1 outcome card `70832a68` FIRST: if the 21 Nov demo produced feedback that changes M2/M3 scope (e.g. "hosted URL" or "separate preview screen"), the scripts must demo the re-ordered scope, not the pre-demo version.

Acceptance criterion: both cards carry a demo script comment in the M1 format (steps table with timings, data to use, acceptance checklist, questions for management, live-failure fallback), posted before each card's wake_at. Comment on this card with the two card ids once both are written.

Why ProjectManager: the demo script is what management signs off against — it is not build work. The owners run it; the PM writes it.

## PM change of wake (shift #7, 2026-11-19) — and the trade-off it creates

**Wake moved: 2026-11-22T09:00Z → 2026-11-20T10:00Z** (Fri 11:00 Madrid). `due_date` → 2026-11-20.

**Why.** 22 Nov 2026 is a **Sunday**. This card was armed to write the two demo scripts on a day when no seat is on duty, and it is due before M2's owner starts on Monday 23 Nov 09:00Z — the same weekday error as the 21 Nov demo slot (see `2506f948`). Friday 10:00Z is the last working-hour slot that precedes the M2 kickoff.

**The trade-off, stated not hidden.** Your step 3 says to re-read `70832a68` (M1 outcome) first. On Friday 10:00Z that card has **not run yet** — the M1 demo is Sat 21 Nov 13:00Z, or Mon 23 Nov if `2506f948` applies its recommended Option B. So:

1. Write both scripts against the **current** M2/M3 scope. That is the scope the owners will start from, and it is correct as of Friday.
2. In each script add a final line, literally: `AMEND AFTER M1 — re-check the 70832a68 feedback before the demo; M2/M3 script amendments are owned by 70832a68.`
3. **`70832a68` owns the post-demo amendment**, not you. Do not leave this card open to chase the feedback — it wakes before the feedback exists by design, and an open card keeps its wake.
4. If the M1 demo produces feedback that changes M2 scope, that is a re-forecast decision on `70832a68`, and the scripts are amended there in the same session.

**Unchanged:** the M1 script on `b9aaf03c` remains the template; management must be able to diff two demos. Do not invent a new format.

(Filed by the ProjectManager, shift #7, 2026-11-19. This card is a management artefact — I write the scripts, the owners run them.)

## PM addendum (shift #7, turn 4) — you wake **two hours before** the decision that may delete one of your two deliverables

My turn-1 ruling moved you to Fri **20 Nov 10:00Z** and told you to write both scripts against current scope, with a post-demo amendment owned by `70832a68`. That ruling missed an input you wake *before*: **`e70e0272` decides at 12:00Z whether `codx-junior-platform` is in scope at all**, and **M3 is application code in that repo** (`api/codx/junior/efforts/*`, `model/effort.py`, `api/efforts.py`, `efforts.js`, `EffortsSettings.vue`).

So at 10:00Z you cannot know whether M3 has a demo to script. Writing a confident M3 script then would fabricate a walkthrough for a milestone that noon might re-slice. That is the same defect I have corrected four times this shift: an unconditional instruction whose answer arrives later.

### Do this instead — split, don't guess

1. **M2 (`299d12ce`) — write it in full, unconditionally.** M2 is installer/proxy/preview work and is in scope under every branch of `e70e0272`. Same M1 format on `b9aaf03c`: steps table with timings, data to use, acceptance checklist, 2 questions for management, live-failure fallback. This is the deliverable that matters for 23/25 Nov.
2. **M3 (`140668fe`) — write the *skeleton only***: format, timings, the 2 management questions, the live-failure fallback, and the acceptance checklist derived from that card's own DoD. **Leave the demo steps as a placeholder**, literally:
   `DEMO STEPS PENDING e70e0272 (20 Nov 12:00Z) — if A, M3 is re-sliced and these steps are void.`
   Do not invent a Settings walkthrough for code that may be out of scope.
3. **Read `e70e0272`'s answer at the same session if it has landed by the time you finish M2** (you wake 10:00Z, the decision lands 12:00Z — you may or may not still be running). If it has landed, fill in the M3 steps accordingly and say which branch you used. If it has not, stop there. **Do not wake yourself at noon to chase it** — `f681f2cf` (13:00Z) applies that decision to the dependents and owns this.
4. **Still true from turn 1:** stamp each script with `AMEND AFTER M1 — re-check the 70832a68 feedback before the demo.` Post-demo amendment is owned by `70832a68`, not by you. Do not leave this card open waiting for feedback.

**Why the split and not a delay:** M2's script is needed by 23 Nov and is decision-independent; deferring both would put a management artefact behind a question that does not affect it. Deployable beats complete — a finished M2 script plus an honest M3 skeleton is worth more than two speculative scripts.

Also note your M3 script must name the **screenshot owner**: `qa_explorer` was just added to `140668fe` because neither `software_developer` nor `qa_automation` has a browser. Write the step as *"qa_explorer opens Settings → selects an effort → value persists → screenshot"*, not as something the developer does.
